name: background invoice job crashing periodically
prompt: Our background process for sending invoices has a memory issue. After a few hours the worker crashes and supervisor restarts it.

name: double-charged customers via Stripe
prompt: Stripe shows we charged some customers more than once for the same order. Help me investigate the root cause.

name: reports page gets slow on later pages
prompt: When I scroll our reports page it gets really slow after page 5. The first two pages load fine.

name: user sees data from another organization
prompt: A user from Acme reported their account is showing rows that clearly belong to BetaCorp. Looks bad.

name: TLS expired without warning
prompt: Our site went down on the weekend because the certificate expired. We thought renewal was automatic. Help us harden this.

name: new product page never appears in search
prompt: We launched the product hub three months ago. It's still nowhere to be seen on Google for any of our terms.

name: dashboard looks like every SaaS template
prompt: Investors said our admin dashboard looks like a generic Tailwind starter — purple gradient, sidebar, the works. Help us actually differentiate visually.

name: Compose service can't talk to DB on prod
prompt: Our app boots fine locally but on the server the API gives 500s on the first request after deploy because it can't talk to Postgres yet.
